title: Certification Preservation Audit — Domain E Clone De-Certification Impact

pack_a_section_e_coverage.topics_preserved_detail: All seed topics (above) remain Certified. The ~37 clones being de-certified test the same 4 topics (AP duplicate invoice, payroll terminated employee, user access recertification, control exception root cause) as their respective seeds (E.038-E.042), which remain Certified. Zero unique topic coverage is lost.
pack_a_section_e_coverage.gap_detail: No Domain E LOS gap is introduced. Cross-check against Pack B Section E (75 items) and Pack E Section E (75 items, covering all 17 COSO principles + ERM + SOX + audit + fraud + IT controls + BCP/DR + sampling) confirms comprehensive Domain E coverage independent of Pack A Section E clones.

information_and_communication.by: Pack E E-E.006; Pack A E.004, 033

verdict_rationale: Domain E retains 171 Certified items across 3 packs after de-certification of ~37 Pack A Section E clones. The 4 clone topics (AP duplicate invoice control, payroll terminated employee control, user access recertification, control exception root cause) each retain their seed item (E.038-E.042) in Pack A as Certified. Pack B Section E (75) and Pack E Section E (75) independently provide comprehensive Domain E coverage across all CMA Part 1 LOS areas: COSO IC (all 17 principles), COSO ERM, SOX/ICFR/PCAOB, internal audit governance, fraud prevention/detection, IT general & application controls, BCP/DR, control activities, risk assessment, monitoring, and information & communication. No LOS gap is introduced.
recommendation_detail: The ~37 clone items being de-certified contribute zero incremental LOS coverage beyond their seeds. The 45.6% post-archive Domain E certification rate is low but reflects DL-012 archival of Pack C/D Section E (150 items), not coverage gaps in the delivery pool. The 171 remaining Certified items provide full and redundant Domain E coverage. Priority should shift to certifying Pack C/D Section E seeds (S808-S809) rather than preserving certified clones.
caveats: The exact count of Certified clones in Pack A Section E (~37) is an estimate — the definitive clone list (DL-033) identifies 16 already-Archived clones. The remaining ~37 would include clones still in Certified state (046, 047, 049, 050, 054, 055, 057, 058, 062, 063, 065, 066, 070, 071, 073, 074 not yet Archived + additional clone-adjacent items)
Pack A Section E uses dual-block architecture (metadata Block 1 + content Block 2). DL-016 metadata-content shift may cause scan artifacts when identifying clones.
Pack E Section E items are structurally clean but educationally thin (median EC=67 chars, 0 ASC/COSO citations per S802) — this is a pedagogical quality concern, not a coverage concern.
The Domain E 45.6% certification rate should be the next strategic target after Pack C/D Section E seed certification (S808-S809, adding 38 seeds = 209 Certified, 55.7%)
